title: Oozy Peppery Argentinian Chestnut Casserole
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Argentinian dish featuring cooked chestnuts in a peppery and gooey sauce, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, saute the chopped onion and minced garlic over medium heat until softened.
Add the cooked chestnuts, smoked paprika, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour in the low sodium vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the low fat heavy cream and shredded gruyere cheese until the cheese is melted and the sauce is gooey.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
